subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Urogynaecology: POP-Q prolapse staging, stress and urgency urinary incontinence

steps.tx: The International Continence Society standardizes prolapse assessment using the **POP-Q system**. This objective staging framework measures six precise anatomical points (Aa and Ba on the anterior vaginal wall, C and D on the cervix or posterior fornix, and Ap and Bp on the posterior vaginal wall) in centimeters relative to the hymenal ring. Landmark locations above the hymen carry negative integer values, while points protruding beyond the hymen carry positive values.
steps.say: The ICS standardized prolapse assessment with the POP-Q system. It measures six points on the anterior wall, cervix, and posterior wall in centimeters relative to the hymen. Measurements inside the vagina are negative, while protrusions outside are positive.

rows: Anterior wall, 3 cm proximal to urethral meatus
Most dependent position of anterior vaginal wall
Most distal edge of cervix or vaginal cuff
Posterior wall, 3 cm proximal to hymen
Most dependent position of posterior vaginal wall

steps.tx: Clinical staging under the POP-Q system categorizes descent into five functional stages based on the leading prolapsing edge. **Stage 0** represents perfect anatomical support with no descent. Stage I descent terminates greater than one centimeter above the hymen. Stage II descent lies between one centimeter above and one centimeter below the hymen. Stage III extends beyond plus one centimeter, while Stage IV represents complete procidentia with total vaginal eversion.
steps.say: POP-Q categorizes prolapse into five stages. Stage zero indicates normal support. Stage one remains well above the hymen, stage two sits around the hymeneal ring, stage three protrudes significantly outward, and stage four represents complete vaginal eversion.

left.title: POP-Q Stage II
points: Leading edge between -1 cm and +1 cm relative to hymen
Sits right at introital introitus under strain
Often managed with pelvic floor therapy or vaginal pessary
Asymptomatic patients do not require surgical intervention

right.title: POP-Q Stage IV (Procidentia)
points: Complete vaginal eversion beyond hymeneal ring
Leading edge at or beyond (Total Vaginal Length - 2 cm)
Causes vaginal mucosal ulceration, excoriation, and hydronephrosis
Requires definitive surgical suspension (sacrocolpopexy or colpocleisis)

steps.tx: Female urinary incontinence comprises two distinct physiological entities that require accurate clinical differentiation. **Stress urinary incontinence** features involuntary urine leakage during sudden increases in intra-abdominal pressure (coughing, laughing, exercise) due to urethral hypermobility or intrinsic sphincter deficiency. In contrast, **urgency urinary incontinence** involves involuntary leakage immediately preceded by a sudden, compelling desire to void, caused by involuntary detrusor smooth muscle overactivity.
steps.say: Urinary incontinence includes two primary conditions. Stress incontinence is involuntary leakage during coughing or exertion due to weakened urethral support. Urgency incontinence is sudden, uncontrollable leakage caused by involuntary bladder muscle spasms.

rows: Running water, cold exposure, key in door
Combination of physical effort and urgency
Surgical sling after urgency is controlled

steps.tx: Surgical management of stress urinary incontinence revolutionized patient care with the introduction of the tension-free **mid-urethral sling**. Placed beneath the mid-urethra via retropubic (tension-free vaginal tape / TVT) or transobturator (TOT) approaches, the synthetic polypropylene mesh provides a static backboard against which the urethra is compressed during cough-induced abdominal pressure spikes, achieving long-term cure rates exceeding eighty-five percent.
steps.say: Surgical treatment for stress incontinence relies on the tension-free mid-urethral sling. Synthetic polypropylene mesh is placed beneath the mid-urethra, providing a supportive backboard that compresses the urethra during coughing, achieving cure rates over eighty-five percent.
